headline: HelloFresh Workers File Class-Action Suit Alleging Abuse and Denied Breaks
summary: Workers at a HelloFresh facility in New Jersey filed a class-action lawsuit alleging verbal and physical abuse alongside denied bathroom breaks, claims denied by the company.
why: HelloFresh is a meal kit delivery service operating large fulfillment centers where labor practices and employee welfare regulations are subject to legal scrutiny.

impacts.name: HelloFresh
impacts.why: Allegations of labor law violations and employee mistreatment pose reputational and legal risks for the company.
